notes.title: New update and xmas sale -33%!
notes.content:
We've added the most upvoted feature "Team-play" to Castle Chaos.
Now you can play 2 vs 2, 3 vs 1, mix AI-bots and human players.

A much requested feature was "Online play" so now we have added this feature to the list for you to vote on.

Here is the complete list of future features:
oddcometgames.com/#/game/castlechaos

So check out what we have in store and vote on the features you feel are the most important.
